test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, if ELEVEN is coded as GNGXGP, TWENTY is coded as VYGPVA, then what will FORTY be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**ELEVEN is coded as GNGXGP,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/098f233663b1ed3207e92a57639a3219bd2c0831b824a34883d7cb9d2da3c339.png] 

**TWENTY is coded as VYGPVA,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd2a06d091fdc3899d54bf31d7cb8c028614ec2a388ee6df5b41b3d5c5ac7806.png] 

Similarly,

**'**FORTY**' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/965292b835f0c9e650e113329d6d4c72b67ded8afa5992db8576212ba5a3f710.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****HQTVA"**.
